messages:
Ana R: Quick sync — Sienna AI just sent final model artifacts. We need to confirm redistribution terms for quantized weights + whether they permit us to publish a marketplace SKU bundled with HW partners. Short answers pls.
Kevin L: Are they proposing a custom dual-license or an off-the-shelf permissive license? I skimmed the doc, looks like 'permissive-with-notice' + export exceptions. Need the exact clause. :thinking:
Maria P: I have the contract draft. They want attribution + a redistribution notice, and they disallow reselling raw weights separately. That part matters for marketplace packaging.
Samir V: For the cloud marketplace SKU, do we treat the bundle as "service only" (no weights distributed) or ship a VM image with weights? Our preferred is service-only to avoid redistribution risk.
Elena G: Product POV: customers expect an "on-prem image" option for enterprise. If Sienna forbids redistribution of raw weights, can we offer image-based deployment where weights are encrypted and not exportable?
Kevin L: Encryption + HSM/KMS gating is OK, but clause says "no redistribution of unmodified weights" — they might allow transform/quantize if we preserve provenance header. Need to negotiate a carve-out for quantization for inference optimization.
Ana R: Can someone paste the precise license sentence we need Sienna to amend? I can take to legal ops.
partnerships-bot: Checklist added: onboarding_doc, sprocket_logistics, hw_partner_agreement, marketplace_SKU_spec. See /docs/onboarding/sienna. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Maria P: Suggested amendment: "Permitted transformations for inference (including quantization and pruning) are allowed provided attribution and a provenance header are preserved; redistribution of raw model weights in unencrypted form is prohibited."
Kevin L: OK that's reasonable. Add: "Redistribution within a licensed appliance or encrypted VM image is permitted if export controls are met and tooling prevents direct extraction."
Samir V: For revenue split with HW partner — we should propose 70/20/10 (Redwood/HW partner/Sienna) for the first 12 months while we validate. Thoughts?
Elena G: 70/20/10 is aggressive but matches our standard for joint-bundles. We need SI uplift budget too. Add a one-time integration fee to the partner.
Ana R: Timeline: we need legal sign-off by Friday to hit the marketplace onboarding window next month. Kevin, can you turn the amendment into redlined language?
Kevin L: I'll post redline in channel by EOD. Also tagging @Maria P for commercial terms.
Maria P: noted, will draft SKU spec (service-only + encrypted appliance option) and pricing sheet.
Samir V: Ops question — does Dedicated support need extra telemetry permissions from Sienna for performance tuning? They currently ask for minimal telemetry. We need tokenized traces for latency SLOs.
Elena G: We can do aggregated telemetry (no training data), send by default opt-in for enterprise. Put that in the product appendix.
Ana R: Great. If legal + commercial align today, I'll schedule a joint announcement sync with Sienna + HW partner next Tue. Prefer no PR before contract is signed.
Kevin L: Redline coming.
Maria P: Pricing sheet draft uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/sienna/sku-pricing (permission: partnerships).
Samir V: I'll prepare a short SI checklist for integration.
Elena G: Add me to announcement planning thread once contract is final. :eyes:
Ana R: Thanks everyone — moving to 1:1s now, ping me for any blockers.
